kjv: Having damnation, because they (the younger widows) have cast off their first faith
mine: and so incur condemnation for having abandoned their (the younger widows') former faith
note: krima is judgment or censure (for breaking a pledge to serve as an enrolled widow); "damnation" makes remarriage a cause of eternal loss.

kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows
mine: If any believing woman has relatives who are widows
note: TR "pistos e piste" (man or woman) against "piste" alone (Sinaiticus, A, C, F, G).
